dialogues.speaker: Najah
dialogues.text: Who would've thought that heathen would be capable of something like this?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You must be pretty angry to use a word like that. Who are you talking about?

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Ahem, since you asked so earnestly, I'll have to share my complaints with you!

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: It's about the organizer, Kautilya... that arrogant and self-indulging researcher. Don't you guys find him repulsive?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh...? Wha...? Oh! Yeah!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We haven't really spoken to him before... But isn't it a little rude to talk about someone in public?

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Oh, you don't need to worry about that! I was his student and experienced my share of his tyranny along with countless others!

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Man, that Kautilya guy knows nothing about respect. He summoned his students like servants, making us do all sorts of chores for him for free...

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: And when it came to our theses, he would either brush us off by telling us that he was busy with work, send them back, reject them, or sometimes just refuse to look at them. He's ruined the academic futures of more than a few students!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's terrible!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's terrible!

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Thankfully, he went off to focus on some research project later on, and another researcher took over our theses. If that didn't happen, my future would've been ruined as well...

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: I wasn't surprised when I heard that his sour reputation followed him everywhere he went! He's even rude to people more distinguished than him. I'd be shocked if someone with a personality like his ever made it anywhere!

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: When he was speaking on the podium, he said, "the winner carries on Mr. Elchingen's legacy..." In some places, you could only say something like that about someone who had already passed away.

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: How could anyone bear to listen to him? He accepted Mr. Elchingen's generous donation and immediately spoke about him as if he were dead. Wouldn't you be irritated if you had to work with him?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There's no need to get so upset...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, you said you don't need to listen to him at all anymore, so there's no need to get so angry. You should be happy now that you have nothing to do with him!

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Hmph... I suppose you do have a point.

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: I was planning on badmouthing him a little more, but from the looks of things, there's no need to torment myself over it anymore. I should be celebrating!

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Thank you, I feel much better now...

choices.text: (You give Paimon a signal with your eyes.)

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Ahem, since you asked so genuinely, I shall share it with you.

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: This competition's "Floral Jelly" is pretty neat. It's basically a gel concocted from a special type of plant. Not only can it store nutrients and potions Fungi need for an extended period, but it also makes it easier for the Fungi to absorb them...

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: The skills that the Fungi gain from using the Floral Jelly are only temporary and won't deal lasting damage to their opponents. Any wounds will automatically heal shortly after the competition is over.

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: You know, Fungi don't exactly "eat" anything. Instead, they "absorb" nutrients from a specific environment through a unique process. So, as you can see, it would be pretty troublesome to have the Fungi consume something solid...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Absorbing" doesn't sound any different from "eating"...

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: "Absorbing" and "eating" are two completely different things!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Take it easy... We're not being nitpicky... It's just, "eating" sounds simpler and it's easier to understand...

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Erm... I'm sorry, I don't mean to take it out on you... It might be because my thesis has been scrutinized too many times, and I've picked up some bad habits along the way.

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: I can't let myself turn into Kautilya. I have to be zen... Have to be zen...

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Anyways, I have no idea how that guy managed to make something as amazing as Floral Jelly. From an academic perspective, he truly created something great.

response.speaker: Najah
response.text: Hmm... Maybe I can recreate it using the same method as to make a pudding with flour and other ingredients...
